explain.en: Python packages pip has downloaded or built. When needed, pip downloads them again and rebuilds the ones it compiled. Installed packages and environments are not affected.
explain.zh: pip 下载过或自己编译过的 Python 包。需要时 pip 会重新下载，编译过的会重新编译。已经装好的包和环境不受影响。

evidence.note: Present on the maintainer's Mac: 360M. macOS 26.6.2.

notes: XDG_CACHE_HOME is honoured on macOS only from pip 26.2; the default path is always scanned too. pip.conf cache-dir can also relocate it: needs a resolver.
